stories.headline: Christa Pike's prognosis still unclear after failed execution, lawyer says
stories.description: Pike's lawyer says doctors are still trying to clear two lethal doses of pentobarbital from her body.

stories.headline: Ukraine ready for US-backed talks with Russia: Zelenskyy
stories.description: Trilateral talks could happen this month in UAE or another US-proposed venue, says the president.

stories.headline: Yemen government announces major operation to retake Houthi territory
stories.description: The Yemeni president's announcement comes amid an exchange of strikes between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition.

stories.headline: US Marine arrested over murder of woman in Okinawa, Japan
stories.description: Japan's government lodged a formal protest with the US, demanding that military officials take action.

stories.headline: Mass protests demanding poll chief resignation shake India for third day
stories.description: Protesters say the election commission’s voter-roll revision has removed millions of eligible voters to benefit PM Modi.
